up: Return the exact activity values, canonical SMILES structures, and ChEMBL IDs for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649956. Include the standard relation, standard value, and standard units for the activities.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649956'
